credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.subtitle: Encrypted secrets resolved by the runtime at request time. Values are write-only: Studio can replace a secret but never read it back.
credentials.apiMissing: This runtime does not expose the Studio credentials API yet; rebuild and restart AgentFlow, then reopen Credentials.
credentials.disabledNote: The credential store is disabled. Set runtime.credentials.enabled: true and CREDENTIALS_MASTER_KEY to manage secrets here.
credentials.disabledGuidance: Set runtime.credentials.enabled: true and CREDENTIALS_MASTER_KEY, restart AgentFlow, then reopen this screen.
credentials.emptyGuidance: Store an API key or token here; loops reference it by name and the runtime injects the value at request time.
credentials.fingerprintTitle: The last four characters of the secret
credentials.deleteMessageEngine:
Delete credential "{service}" from the engine-wide bucket?

Any loop or config reference that resolves it will fail until a new secret is stored.
credentials.deleteMessageUser:
Delete credential "{service}" from user {user}?

Any loop or config reference that resolves it will fail until a new secret is stored.
credentials.editorSubtitle: Stored encrypted, resolved by the runtime at request time, and never shown again.
credentials.hint.secret: Write-only: the stored value is encrypted at rest and never returned by the API. Leave blank on an edit to keep it.
credentials.hint.sentAs: Sent as <header>: <scheme> <value>. Defaults are Authorization: Bearer <value>.
credentials.placeholder.secretKeep: leave blank to keep the stored value
credentials.bucketDialog.title: Open a user bucket
credentials.bucketDialog.subtitle: Credentials are keyed by (user uuid, service). A user without a stored credential still needs to be named to add one.
credentials.bucketDialog.hint: Per-user credentials resolve only for that tenant. Leave empty to use the engine-wide bucket.
credentials.bucketDialog.error: Enter a user UUID, or cancel and use the Engine-wide bucket.
